comments.author: gigarogue
comments.body_html:
I tried to use this mod on headless to play with a friend. It didn’t work at the beggining because I missunderstood something. After hours of hard testing, it worked well. Moreover, my headless sever has 27 mods.

So, To make it work, You will have to :

  • Install the latest version of SAIN on the server host
  • Install manually big brain
  • Install manually More bot api for everyone, including headless and clients host.
  • If you play with a friend, both of you needs to install exactly the same new bot mod. Otherwise you will both get stuck in infinite raid loading loop.

Last thing, if you are stuck in infinite loading profile screen, you didn’t unistall / install the mods properly.

Sorry for my baguette english.

comments.author: HANK032
comments.body_html: Hey, I actually ran into the infinite loading screen issue too, but I managed to fix it! ​Here’s how to fix it: ​Step 1: The Clean Uninstall First, delete MoreBotsAPI, SAIN, Bigbrain, and Waypoints. Make sure you wipe them out completely to prevent any other errors down the line. ​Step 2: Reinstall (Order Matters!) Redownload the mods and extract them into your folder strictly in this order. Seriously, make sure you drag them in one by one: ​Bigbrain ​Waypoints ​SAIN ​MoreBotsAPI ​Reinstalling them in this exact order is what did the trick for me. ​A bit of context: When I first installed these mods, everything worked perfectly. But after playing for a few months, it suddenly started hard-stucking on the loading screen out of nowhere—even though I hadn’t added any new mods or touched the files at all. ​At first, I thought my files were just corrupted, so I nuked the entire game and the mod folder. Honestly, I was too lazy to re-download everything and rebind all my keys, but after going back to the vanilla game and experiencing absolute hell, I just had to come back and figure this out. That’s when I realized this specific mod pack was the culprit. Once I reinstalled them in the proper order, everything went back to normal. It seems like there might be a hidden bug that triggers randomly, so if it breaks, a clean reinstall is the way to go. ​Hope this helps you out! If you’re still stuck, just reply to this post. If I catch your message, I’d be more than happy to help—this mod pack is honestly way too fun to miss out on.
